EXECUTION REQUEST

I want to use an execution-capable owner session.

Do not use a read-only planning session.

Connect this session to my owner GitHub repository, GitHub Actions, Render service, and IVX owner runtime.

First verify and report:

1. GitHub owner authentication: PASS/FAIL
2. GitHub Actions write access: PASS/FAIL
3. Repository write access: PASS/FAIL
4. Render deployment access: PASS/FAIL
5. IVX owner runtime authentication: PASS/FAIL

If any item is FAIL, tell me the exact UI action I must perform to authorize it.

Once all are PASS:

- Repair invalid GitHub workflow files.
- Commit and push the fixes.
- Re-run failed GitHub Actions.
- Return the new commit SHA.
- Return workflow results.
- Return deployment status.
- Return any remaining blockers with evidence.

Do not stay in planning mode. Switch to execution mode if supported.
